notes.title: Beta version 1.2
notes.content:
Been pretty busy as of late and with the start of the new year I wanted to provide a glimpse into the ascension modes.  Biggest gameplay change is that your cleanse can be recharged on a fastball bounce so be sure to use them!  Synergies are currently being worked upon to 

CHANGES:

 Cleanses can now be recharged on fast juggle
 Character screen has more info
 9 ascension levels
 Info screen for stats
 Heal at shop
 Time stops now in-between wave instead of slows
 Indicator has been made more visual for next disk launch
 Surya's chakra now shows correct damage amount
 Slow Time on boss reveal
 Oroborus now applies hit instead of just remove heart (wink wink)
 Icons included in tutorial
 Added more items
 Stuck disks now despawn
 Visual on pagan when cleanse happens


FIXES:

Ball will kick out if hit along side (when they get stuck along edges)
Meta progression saves correctly now and no longer indicates false purchases
Grammatical errors fixed
Boss kill item now not automatically highlights previous relic
Weapon no longer pre-fires prior to start of level
Explosive Bonus now displays correctly
Free item purchase on store no longer works
Appropriate settings now saved
Added slow down for background to help accessibility
Fixed contrast setting to have greater visibility
2 menu overlay fixed


NEXT UP:

 Localization font change
 More items
 More bosses
 SFX updates

notes.title: 1.07 Update
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed

 Button should be highlighted in events properly
 Fixed event softlock that could happen
 Items based on ball count should count correctly


Features

 2 new events
 Damage numbers can be turned off
 Cleanse gives a brief iframe (so you can use it if our about to get hit).  its only for .2 seconds tho so gotta time it well
 Contrast Slider added in settings if background is too dark to visibly see enemies
 Skull wave that possibly happens in wave 7 greatly reduced


Next up

Difficulty ascension mode (allready in progress)
Rework naamah (already in progress)
More Items
More events
More meta progressions
Quick restart

notes.title: Patch 1.06 & new Trailer!
notes.content:
BUGS

Fixed tutorial soft lock
Fixed rare event soft lock
Removing items now works within events (careful now).
Localization messaging for missing language should now just default to english.
Typos fixed.


UPDATES

New mystery events.
Fastballs now deal 1.5 disk damage.
Skull wave should be a bit more forgiving.
Removed difficulty temporarily.


PLANNED

Rework difficulty settings to be more aligned with ascension mode like slay the spire.
Slider for contrast in settings.
More events.
More Items.
More Characters.
Bug Fixes.
Rework Naamah.

notes.title: Demo Update 1.04
notes.content:
BUGS

Gjallarhorn is now working correctly and no longer 1 shots everything
Graphical glitch with flash should now be fixed
Nabonidus Cylinder should now count disks correctly
Penetrating bullets should now hit directly next target
Fire dot can no longer double up

Few new items

notes.title: Demo released! and updated!
notes.content:
Changes

 Tweaked Item rarities
 Gave Demo characters juggle focused abilities
 Altered waves 1 through 5
 Electric Skull event made more forgiving
 UI indicator will tell you procs that happen on next successful bounce (Only guarenteed not luck based)
 Increased all demo characters HP
 Altered starting Items for Demo characters
 Tweaked prayer beads to proc on juggle not fast ball juggle


Bugs

 Fixed Audio glitch with bosses not playing
 Fixed visual glitches
 Altered lazy homing for homing projectiles to be better focused
 Duplicate Items in store removed


Planned Update for Demo

 Rework difficulties to be unlockable and have a global Ascension mode. 
 Show curses prior to wave begin
 additional bug fixes
